core_obligations: Reduce to sheaves (proof lines 7839-7845): passing to the cohomology sheaves and using the bounded below hypothesis, the author reduces the assertion to the case where all K_i are sheaves concentrated in a single degree.
Apply the sheaf case (proof lines 7845-7850): for sheaves the commutation is the companion statement about cohomology of a direct sum of sheaves, which gives the result for complexes as well.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the case of sheaves using the bounded below hypothesis.
Apply the companion commutation for sheaves.
Conclude the statement for bounded below complexes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the etale cohomology of a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme commutes with arbitrary direct sums of bounded below complexes (statement lines 7830-7837). The proof reduces to the case of sheaves through the cohomology sheaves and the bounded below hypothesis (proof lines 7839-7845) and then applies the companion commutation of cohomology with direct sums for sheaves (proof lines 7845-7850). The non-formal content is the reduction from complexes to sheaves. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one companion input.
